faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application form for Central Electronics (CEL) Recruitment 2026 is 29 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Central Electronics (CEL) has announced a total of 8 vacancies for various Deputy Engineer and Officer on Contract Basis posts. These positions are available across different engineering disciplines and management roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for CEL Deputy Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Deputy Engineer and Officer posts in CEL Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via speed post or courier.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Deputy Engineer posts at CEL?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Deputy Engineer and Officer posts at Central Electronics (CEL) is 30 years, as calculated on 31 July 2026. Age relaxations may apply as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Deputy Engineer on Contract Basis?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Deputy Engineer on Contract Basis and Officer - Stores on Contract Basis roles at CEL will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for CEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for CEL Recruitment 2026 should possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in relevant engineering disciplines or an MBA/PGDM/PGP in Supply Chain/Materials Management from a recognized institute, with minimum 55% marks.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Deputy Engineer and Officer posts under Central Electronics (CEL) Recruitment 2026 is Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. Candidates should be prepared to work at this location.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for CEL Recruitment 2026 involves an initial scrutiny of applications to shortlist eligible candidates, followed by an interview process for those who are shortlisted. Final selection is based on performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for CEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: An application fee of Rs. 500/- is applicable for all categories of candidates applying for the Central Electronics (CEL) Recruitment 2026. This fee needs to be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the application form for CEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official application form for CEL Recruitment 2026 from the official website, www.celindia.co.in. It is crucial to fill the form accurately and attach all necessary documents before sending it.
